complexDefinition.stringValue: Request (someone) to do or give something.

definition.stringValue: To request something from someone.

text.stringValue: Запросить что-то у кого-то.
**Ask** him if he can lend you his car tomorrow.
May I **ask** you to pass the salt, please?
She decided to **ask** her boss for a raise.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Inquire about something.

definition.stringValue: To make an inquiry.

text.stringValue: Сделать запрос.
**Ask** your teacher if there’s any homework for the weekend.
Did you **ask** about the price of that dress?
Let me **ask** for directions at the next gas station.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Invite (someone) to one's home or a function.

definition.stringValue: To invite someone to an event or place.

text.stringValue: Пригласить кого-то на мероприятие или в какое-то место.
**Ask** him to dinner, he would love the company.
Jane decided to **ask** Mark to the concert.
Will you **ask** your classmates to join our study group?

complexDefinition.stringValue: Say something in order to obtain an answer or some information.

definition.stringValue: To question to get information.

text.stringValue: Задавать вопросы, чтобы получить информацию.
**Ask** her about the book she's reading.
He will **ask** the teacher about the homework.
I need to **ask** for directions to the museum.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Consider or discuss the possibility or advantages of a particular course of action.

definition.stringValue: To consider or discuss a possible action.

text.stringValue: Рассматривать или обсуждать возможное действие.
**Ask** yourself if risking your job is worth it.
Will you **ask** the group about changing the location of the meeting?
**Ask** your roommate whether they'd be okay with getting a cat.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Require or demand as a requisite for survival or success.

definition.stringValue: To need something to succeed or survive.

text.stringValue: Нуждаться в чем-то для достижения успеха или выживания.
**Ask** your heart out when there's no one else around.
Bright Future Program **asks** for quite a lot of volunteers.
3 years abroad would **ask** much patience from anyone.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Make a request of (someone).

definition.stringValue: To demand something from someone.

text.stringValue: Требовать что-то от кого-то.
**Ask** him to return the book he borrowed.
I will **ask** for a refund for the faulty product.
Why don't you **ask** her for an apology?

complexDefinition.stringValue: Direct or aim something, such as a question, at someone.

definition.stringValue: To aim a question at someone.

text.stringValue: Целиться вопросом в кого-то.
**Ask** your teacher about the homework.
I will **ask** him where he bought his jacket.
Can you **ask** her for directions to the station?

complexDefinition.stringValue: Pray or beg to (a supposed source of magical or spiritual power).

definition.stringValue: To pray or beg a spiritual or magical entity.

text.stringValue: Молиться или умолять духовную или магическую сущность.
**Ask** your guardian angel for guidance in your dreams.
She decided to **ask** the spirits for help in finding love.
He will **ask** the universe for serenity and internal peace.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Propose marriage to someone.

definition.stringValue: To propose marriage to someone.

text.stringValue: Сделать кому-то предложение о браке.
**Ask** her at the most romantic moment possible.
He got down on one knee to **ask** her.
Deciding to **ask** him was the best decision she made.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Bid, as a price.

definition.stringValue: To suggest a price.

text.stringValue: Предложить цену.
**Ask** $15 for your old bicycle.
She decided to **ask** $200 for the antique lamp.
He'll probably **ask** around $500 for the vintage guitar.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Call for an answer, as in a quiz.

definition.stringValue: To call for an answer in a quiz.

text.stringValue: Запросить ответ в викторине.
**Ask** her the capital of Japan.
Can you **ask** him the meaning of this word?
Give the kids a math problem to **ask** them.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Verbally address a question to.

definition.stringValue: To pose a question verbally.

text.stringValue: Задать вопрос устно.
**Ask** the teacher about the homework assignment.
Can you **ask** him where he put the car keys?
You should **ask** for a refund at the customer service desk.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Specify as a condition or requirement.

definition.stringValue: To set a condition or requirement.

text.stringValue: Установить условие или требование.
**Ask** for patience from those assisting you.
I **ask** for respect in my relationships.
They **ask** for dedication from all team members.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Pose a question to other participants in a conversation or discussion.

definition.stringValue: To ask a question in a conversation.

text.stringValue: Задать вопрос в беседе.
**Ask** Joe about his new job promotion.
Can you **ask** the teacher for extra help?
She didn't **ask** for my opinion on her new haircut.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Apply to a religious figure for intercession.

definition.stringValue: To pray to a religious figure.

text.stringValue: Молиться религиозной фигуре.
**Ask** God for strength in your struggles.
She decided to **ask** Allah for guidance.
He'll **ask** Buddha for inner peace.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Inform oneself by asking a question.

definition.stringValue: To seek information through a question.

text.stringValue: Искать информацию с помощью вопроса.
**Ask** your teacher about the homework assignment.
She decided to **ask** him for directions to the station.
Why don't we **ask** the manager about the new policy?

complexDefinition.stringValue: Express a certain thought or impression through speech.

definition.stringValue: To express a thought by asking.

text.stringValue: Выразить мысль, задав вопрос.
**Ask** the teacher about the homework.
Did you **ask** for help?
Always remember to **ask** before taking anything.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Set a certain price for a good or service.

definition.stringValue: To set a price for something.

text.stringValue: Установить цену на что-то.
**Ask** $20 for the vintage purse at the yard sale.
The seller may **ask** a premium for the waterfront property.
Why did she **ask** such a high price for the painting?

complexDefinition.stringValue: A request or demand.

definition.stringValue: A demand or request.

text.stringValue: Требование или запрос.
**Ask** for a salary raise was rejected.
They placed an **ask** for more school funding.
Her biggest **ask** was simply more time off work.
